question.problem:
$$
P=[\begin{aligned}\frac{3}{\sqrt{18}} & -\frac{3}{\sqrt{18}} \\ \frac{3}{\sqrt{18}} & \frac{3}{\sqrt{18}}\end{aligned}],\,Q=[\begin{aligned}\sqrt{3} & \sqrt{8} \\ \sqrt{8} & 4\sqrt{3}\end{aligned}]
$$

Find $|\text{det}(PQ)|$ given that $P$ is an orthogonal matrix.
question.worked_solution:
We use the following facts: 

- The determinant of a product is equal to the product of the determinants.

- The determinant of an orthogonal matrix $P$ is equal to $\pm 1.$

Applying these ideas, we get the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}|\text{det}(PQ)| & =|\text{det}(P)\cdot \text{det}(Q)| \\  & =|(\pm 1)\cdot \text{det}(Q)| \\  & =|\pm 1|\cdot |\text{det}(Q)| \\  & =|\text{det}(Q)| \\  & =|\sqrt{3}\cdot 4\sqrt{3}-\sqrt{8}\cdot \sqrt{8}| \\  & =4\end{aligned}
$$
